title: A broken icon reads as what breaks it: a crack through a heart, a split egg, a bubble in pieces
goal: Ask tears the outline of anything breaking at its upper right, which suits a balloon but makes a broken heart look bitten and a soap bubble look like a cracked egg. Each way of breaking should look like itself, and an object at its best without the tear should not be made worse by it.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-05. Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --engine ask --cases icon-broken-heart,icon-cracked-egg-filled,icon-soap-bubble-bursting. Tear on, run 20261105-204948-ask: heart 55.4 (asked 5, icon 4), egg 70.6 (6, 5), bubble 54.8 (6, 6, named 1 of 3 as a cracked egg). Tear off for one build, run 20261105-213322-ask: heart 30.5, egg 84.8, bubble 71.3. One reading each, and one version of the balloon has swung by 30. The bubble sheet shows the tool leaves an inner highlight poking into the tear: AskIconBreak.applied leaves parts lying in the torn stretch alone. Ideas: a crack through the object as a second tear shape, chosen by the model from a general list, and dropping parts that lie in the gap. No subject may be coded.
acceptance: A broken heart icon scores at least 7 of 10 on did what was asked and reads as an icon, over three readings
A cracked egg and a bursting soap bubble each score at least as well with the tear as without it, over three readings
The balloon popping stays at or above 85 over three readings

log.note: Adversarial pass: a person asking for a broken heart expects the Lucide/Material look (a jagged crack through it, or two halves); a cracked egg a zigzag split; a bursting bubble an outline flying apart. One tear at the upper right serves only things with a skin. The model cannot write break geometry (2026-11-05), so it now names HOW it breaks from a general list (torn / cracked / shattered) and the tool draws it; no subject anywhere. Risk: the model picking shattered for the balloon, which would lose its 85.

Tried 4 looks for a bursting bubble, one eval reading each (noise is +-20): ring in 4 pieces pushed out 62 (squarish, viewfinder), shreds at one side 32 (sun), one opening + marks 43 (spinner), ring in 4 pieces in place 33 (light bulb). Balloon in pieces 43/54, as an opening 42 (light bulb): the balloon needs its tear. Same-drawing judge A/B on the eval's bubble: tear 34.1, pieces 25.4. Chose two looks (burst = the tear, cracked) over three because no pieces look beat the tear on any drawing; the bubble's weakness is the model's drawing (a drip under it and a shine on the line), not the tear.
owns no walks; the ones it names are examples
